Mushroom Risotto

Patience is the secret ingredient.

Ingredients

1 1/2 cups arborio rice

8 oz mushrooms, sliced

4 cups hot stock

1/2 cup parmesan

Instructions

1. Brown the mushrooms and set them aside.

2. Toast the rice, then add stock a ladle at a time, stirring.

3. Fold in the mushrooms and parmesan.
